author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices finding the hand's place, falling lines, a pattern moved lower, verse and chorus, and counting beats, with a Christmas rooftop song.

classes.title: Land on the rooftop
classes.goal: Find D between the two black keys and rest the hand on D, E, G and A.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the two black keys to find where the hand lives

classes.parentPrompt: Point to the two black keys; help the thumb rest on D, right between them.
classes.childAction: Thumb on D, finger 2 on E, then G and A.
classes.bridge: The two black keys are the chimney; the thumb lands softly right between them.

intro.caption: Land softly, like the reindeer
intro.parentCue: help the thumb rest on D, between the black keys

games.caption: Line up: D, E, G, A
games.parentCue: Say the finger numbers as each key lights

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding the hand's place by a landmark.

classes.title: Hop up and back to G
classes.goal: Play the start of 'Up on the housetop': G, a little hop to A, back to G.

mathTarget.parentLine: Stepping to the next key and coming right back

classes.parentPrompt: Say the finger numbers aloud; you play the low C in this line.
classes.childAction: Play G, hop up to A, come back to G, then E.
classes.bridge: The reindeer hop on the roof: G, a little hop up to A, back to G.

intro.caption: Hop up and back
intro.parentCue: you play the low C; your child plays the rest

games.caption: Up on the housetop, slowly
games.parentCue: Say the finger numbers out loud together

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a pattern that steps away and back.

classes.title: Down the chimney
classes.goal: Play the line where the tune slides down, from A down to D.

mathTarget.parentLine: The tune walks downhill, key by key, to the left

classes.parentPrompt: Slide your hand gently down your child's back as the tune goes down.
classes.childAction: Play A, A, G, E, D, walking down the chimney.
classes.bridge: Going left on the keys is climbing down the chimney: lower and lower.

intro.caption: Down, down the chimney
intro.parentCue: slide your hand down your child's back

games.caption: Out jumps Santa: A, A, G, E, D
games.parentCue: Slide your hand down your child's arm

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a tune that walks down.

classes.title: Ho, ho, ho, then lower
classes.goal: Hear the 'Ho, ho, ho' shape played once, then again a little lower.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same shape again, starting lower

classes.parentPrompt: Play the 'Ho, ho, ho' notes for your child; they answer with 'who wouldn't go?'
classes.childAction: Listen for the ho-ho-ho, then answer: who wouldn't go?
classes.bridge: The second ho-ho-ho is the same jump, one floor down the house.

intro.caption: Same ho-ho-ho, one floor down
intro.parentCue: you play the ho-ho-hos; your child answers

games.caption: Who wouldn't go?
games.parentCue: Sing the words as your child plays

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing the same pattern played lower.

classes.title: Rooftop and ho-ho-ho
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and notice the rooftop verse and the ho-ho-ho chorus.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song can have a story part and a cheering part

classes.parentPrompt: Wave your arms like reindeer on the verse; pat your tummy on the ho-ho-hos. Sing stuck words.
classes.childAction: Play slowly and spot when the ho-ho-ho part comes.
classes.bridge: The verse is the rooftop story; the chorus is everyone cheering 'ho, ho, ho'.

intro.caption: Story part, cheering part
intro.parentCue: pat your tummy when the ho-ho-hos come

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing the verse and chorus of a song.

classes.title: Walk, run-ning, walk
classes.goal: Play the quick 'little ones' notes slowly: two quick notes for one walking beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Quick notes come two for every one walking step

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'walk' for slow notes and 'run-ning' for quick pairs while your child plays.
classes.childAction: Play the quick pairs as run-ning, the slow notes as walk.
classes.bridge: A walking note is one reindeer step; run-ning is two quick hooves.

intro.caption: Walk, walk, run-ning
intro.parentCue: say the words slowly as your child plays

games.caption: All for the little ones, slowly

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: fitting two quick notes into one beat.

classes.title: Four beats, slow and even
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly while counting four beats in every bar.

mathTarget.parentLine: Each bar holds four even beats

classes.parentPrompt: Tap your child's shoulder on each beat, count 1, 2, 3, 4. You play C and F.
classes.childAction: Play slowly while your grown-up counts to four.
classes.bridge: Each bar is four reindeer steps across the roof: one, two, three, four.

intro.caption: Slow and even is best
intro.parentCue: tap your child's shoulder and count to four

games.caption: Tap and count to four
games.parentCue: Count softly as your child taps

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing slowly and evenly in fours.

classes.title: Ride with the sleigh
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music at full speed.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping up with a beat that does not wait

classes.parentPrompt: Nod on each beat and play the C and F notes; if a note slips, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music and keep going, even after a slip.
classes.bridge: The sleigh keeps moving; ride along with it, even past a bump.

intro.caption: Hop on the sleigh
intro.parentCue: nod the beat and smile at slips

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping up with the music together.

classes.title: Rooftop concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy with a jolly, bouncy sound, then bow.

mathTarget.parentLine: Playing the same notes with a cheerful feel

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; announce the song, shout 'ho, ho, ho!' together, then bow.
classes.childAction: Play jolly and bouncy for teddy, then take a bow.
classes.bridge: Soft like reindeer landing on the verse, big and jolly on the ho-ho-hos.

intro.caption: Concert time for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song with a jolly feel.
